name: Diversion Shot [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You can use your shots to distract opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Stealthy, Target of Opportunity.

Benefit(s): When you hit a target using Target of Opportunity, your ally can attempt a Stealth check to hide from your target as an immediate action, even if your target is aware of your ally’s presence. This Stealth check applies only to the target you hit, and the stealth ends if the ally takes any action other than to move in to cover or concealment.
